theme: vaccine line: batch sizes through three stages
title: Vaccine Line: Batch Sizes Through Three Stages
strategies: one-lot-per-pulse (JIT) baseline: every stage produces and consumes in the same hour as each demand pulse, zero decay but maximal setup scrap (reproduces the checker baseline B)
per-stage-isolated EOQ: independently pick the best batching frequency for each of the three stages assuming the other two stay JIT, then combine the three choices into one schedule

joint ratio search: search batching frequencies (k1,k2,k3) for all three stages TOGETHER against the true multi-buffer decay simulation, exploiting that decay compounds multiplicatively across a chain of buffers so the right combination is a matched ratio between adjacent stages, not any stage's quantity picked alone
demand-aware windowing that groups pulses by local density/spacing rather than fixed-size windows
